children: Zapata Quantum CEO Sumit Kapur was named to The Boston Business Journal’s 2026 Power 50: Movement Makers.
Announcement furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8‑K under Regulation FD disclosure.
Recognition cites Kapur’s role in restructuring Zapata Quantum and refocusing on quantum software applications.
Company highlights collaborations with NVIDIA and quantum-enabled drug discovery work recognized by Nature Biotechnology.
Management says rebuilt team adds talent from Harvard, Palantir, Oracle and Northrop Grumman to accelerate commercialization.
